35654409.reason: For a reply at distance d=s-a[s]<=k it adds min(n-s, d) new messages; the correct increment is min(n, s+k) - min(n, a[s]+k), so it overcounts when the parent window ends within k of n. On 0041 message 93536 (parent 92412, k=6475, n=100000) it adds 1124 instead of 1113 and prints 20967 instead of 20956.

35669821.reason: Each message copies its parent's full list of disjoint intervals (NumRange.union copies _data) and length() rescans it, so a reply chain whose windows never merge costs O(n^2). Test 0046 (n=99976, k=1, a[i]=i-3) builds such a chain and exceeds the time limit with and without CRLF.

35675503.reason: When the parent is within k and the current window is clipped at n, it computes the increment as rast + upper_this + 1 - upper_last, which simplifies to 1, instead of n - (a[s]+k). On 0037 (n=10, k=3, message 8 replies to 4) it adds 1 instead of 3 and prints 8 instead of 10.

35676676.reason: While walking up the reply chain, if an ancestor x has x-k<=0 but x>=left_bound, it adds left_bound-(x-k)-1 instead of left_bound-1, counting positions that are already covered. On 0041 message 6477 (parent 299, k=6475) this adds 6177 instead of 1 and prints 19128 instead of 12952.

35684306.reason: It applies the boundary correction dp[i]-- whenever a[i]+k+1>i and a[i]+k+1>n, including when a[i]=0, so the message has no parent and nothing overlaps. On 0008 (n=2, k=2, a=[0,0]) it prints 2 1 instead of 2 2.
